SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code - Chicago Zoning Ordinance, be amended by

changing all thc B3-3 Community Shopping District symbols and indications as shown on Map

No. 5-H in the area bounded by

       North Milwaukee Avenue; West Moffat Street; the alley next southwest of and
       parallel with North Milwaukee Avenue; and a line 44 feet northwest of and parallel
       with the north right-of-way line of West Moffat Street

to those of an Bl-3 Community Shopping District, which is hereby established in the above-
described area.
